frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.title: Bootstrap: Discover the Benefits of Using Bootstrap for Web Development
frontmatter.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to Bootstrap's Features and Advantages
frontmatter.excerpt: Bootstrap is one of the most widely used front-end frameworks for building responsive websites. This in-depth guide breaks down what Bootstrap actually does well, where it falls short, and when it's the right (or wrong) tool for modern web development.
